name: The Path of the Warrior: Art of Fighting 3 R
summary:
Originally released by SNK for the NEO GEO in 1992, Art of Fighting is one of SNK’s flagship fighting game franchises that helped define the early era of competitive fighting games. A spin-off entry in the Art of Fighting series, Art of Fighting 3 is set in Glasshill Valley and follows the battles and personal stories of a diverse cast of martial artists.

Long regarded as the most distinctive entry in the series, this Art of Fighting 3 remaster preserves the original’s unique qualities while introducing modern features, including online multiplayer, rollback netcode, a robust Practice Mode, and a VS Mode. Additionally, two of the most beloved characters in the Art of Fighting series, King and Yuri Sakazaki, make their debut as playable fighters in Art of Fighting 3 R.
